mana_diagnostics.interpretation: Native construction heuristic; lower risk is preferred. This is not an EDHPowerLevel percentage or a playtest result.

construction.score_explanation: The search scores Dinosaur entries, useful discover hits, and ways to keep the engine active across turns.

mana_only_comparison.method: Simplified opening-hand simulation with land drops and early ramp, without opposing interaction.

synergy.summary: Ramp into Pantlaza, discover off Dinosaur entries, and reuse those entries across turns.

highlights.title: Cast Pantlaza early
highlights.description: Set up green mana and early ramp, then cast Pantlaza to discover 4 from its own entry. Look for Nature's Lore, Three Visits, Farseek.

highlights.title: Discover off Dinosaur entries
highlights.description: Use tough Dinosaurs and cards that put them directly onto the battlefield. An unused discover can happen on any player's turn. Look for Regisaur Alpha.

highlights.title: Use blink and play across turns
highlights.description: Blinking Pantlaza returns it as a new object that can discover again. Reuse another Dinosaur's entry when Pantlaza still has its trigger available. Look for Ephemerate.

synergy.model: A neural ranker learns card fit from Oracle text, card characteristics, exact creature types, and collected lists. Pantlaza's optimizer grades discover hits and Dinosaur entries, then prices the mana base against the spell core.
